nme_items: Food, Food Supplements or Dietary Pills (Example, Horlicks, Glucose, Whey Protein, etc.)

Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including but not limited to Vitamins, minerals and organic substances unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of treatment
policy_rules: Tele Consultation (GP & Specialist): Online GP and Specialist consultations are covered. Cashless only. Limit: Unlimited.
Health Check: 1 Health Check per family. Cashless only. Limit: 1 Health Check (INR 1200).
In-Clinic Consultations (GP & Specialist): All in-clinic Allopathy consultations are covered. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 6000.
Prescribed Diagnostics: Covers prescribed diagnostic tests across Pathology & Radiology prescribed by Allopathic practitioner. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 5000.
Vaccination: Covers WHO-approved vaccinations for adults and children. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 2500.
Prescribed Pharmacy: Covers medicines prescribed by Allopathic practitioner. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 5000.

Dental Wellness: Covers Examination, Scaling and Polishing (in case of root canal and extraction), X-ray, Fluoride Treatment, Filling, Prophylaxis, Root Canal Treatment, Extractions, Oral Surgery, Re-cementation, Medication, Restoration, Crowning / Capping, Implants, Braces. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 5000.
Vision Wellness: Covers Consultations & check-ups by optometrist/optician, Prescribed glasses and frames. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 5000.

Dermatology: Covers dermatology consultations and non-cosmetic treatments. Skin related consultations with dermatologists and Treatment related to skin which is non cosmetic in nature covered under Dermatology benefit only. Cashless + Reimbursement. Limit: Up to INR 1500.
Exclusion: Inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments will not be covered.
Exclusion: All non-medical expense or standard deductions incurred during inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments are not covered.
Exclusion: Procedure fees or any type of procedures of fees paid during an OP consultation are not covered (e.g., wound cleaning/dressing).
Exclusion: OTC Medicines or medicines purchased without doctor's prescriptions are not covered.
Exclusion: Diagnostic Tests/Investigations done without doctor's prescriptions are not covered.

Exclusion: All cosmetic related consultations or diagnostics, and medicines are not covered unless called out in inclusions. Cosmetic Surgery or Treatment means surgery or medical treatment solely or primarily to improve or preserve physical appearance.

Exclusion: Treatment for or related to alopecia, baldness, wigs, toupees, Alcoholism, drug/substance abuse, change in gender, IVF, infertility, Maternity, Management of pregnancy, obesity, AYUSH, physiotherapy, Cataract, Lasik, hearing aid, cosmetics are not covered.
Exclusion: AYUSH, physiotherapy, and cosmetic-related consultations are not covered.
Claim Requirement: All claims should be raised within 45 days from the service taken date, otherwise the claim can be rejected.
